conflicts.problem: Both lessons teach the same content: ASF = LSF² for the passport photo, with an algebraic proof. Lesson 7 ends by promising a Volume Scale Factor investigation in Lesson 8, but Lesson 8 repeats the area work. No lesson ever investigates or derives VSF = LSF³, yet Lessons 11 and 12 treat it as established.

Lesson 3 says that in a rectangle the angles stay equal when only one dimension is changed (the distorted Pair C). Lesson 12 says that if only one dimension is scaled, 'angles change'. For the distorted passport photo (a rectangle) the angles stay 90°, so Lesson 12 is wrong. It is the ratio condition that fails.
